purpose: Competitive product radar for Honda Argentina 2027 planning
method: Status reflects Argentina relevance, not only global product confirmation. Risk combines probability of Argentina availability, price/volume potential, segment overlap and Honda exposure.

items.why: Direct NAVI substitute with 150 cc, CVT, CBS, front disc, LED and digital cluster at a materially lower price.
Direct NAVI competitor with 150 cc CVT and richer visible equipment at a lower price.
